summary: Removes a node from a linked list by value. Starting from the head this+0x0, walks the chain of next pointers (node+0x4) comparing each node's value (node+0x0) against a2; returns 0 when a2 is null, the list is empty, or the value is not found. On a match the node is unlinked (previous next or head repointed to the removed node's next), the tracked node pointers this+0x4 and this+0x8 are repointed when they referenced the removed node, and the count this+0xC is decremented. Unless a3 is set, the free-data flag byte at node+0x8 is cleared; when that flag remains set the node's data pointer (node+0x0) is freed via EmptyStub_0170 then FreeWrapper_7bcf. The node itself is always freed with FreeWrapper_7bcf, returning 1 on success. Called by NetworkMessageDispatch (004B54E0).

local_names.this: linked-list controller holding head, tracked node pointers, and count
local_names.a2: node value to search for and remove
local_names.a3: preserve-free-data flag: when non-zero the node data flag is kept and the payload is freed
local_names.v7: removed node's data pointer, freed when the flag byte is set

operations.description: Return 0 immediately when the search value a2 is null
Return 0 when the list head this+0x0 is null (empty list)
Walk the chain from head this+0x0 following next pointers (node+0x4), comparing each node's value (node+0x0) with a2 and tracking the predecessor; return 0 if the chain ends without a match
When the removed node is the tracked node this+0x8, repoint it to the removed node's next pointer (node+0x4)
Unlink the node: when a predecessor exists, set its next (node+0x4) to the removed node's next; otherwise the head this+0x0 becomes the removed node's next
When the removed node is the tracked node this+0x4, repoint it to the predecessor
Decrement the list count this+0xC by one
When a3 is zero, clear the free-data flag byte at node+0x8; then, when that flag byte is set, free the node's data pointer (node+0x0) through EmptyStub_0170 followed by FreeWrapper_7bcf
Free the removed node itself with FreeWrapper_7bcf
Return 1 to signal successful removal (and 0 on the earlier failure guards)
